name: Anita S.
comment: My 72-year-old father came home with 4 medications in unreadable doctor handwriting. This tool identified his diabetes and blood pressure pills within seconds and gave us a clean morning/night schedule.

name: Dr. Arvinder M.
comment: As a pharmacist, I am deeply impressed by how well this flags drug interactions and translates Latin codes like TDS and PC into simple patient instructions. Excellent patient education tool.

name: David L.
comment: The printable medication card is incredible! I downloaded the PDF and stuck it right on our refrigerator so my wife and I never double-dose my inhalers.

name: Pooja V.
comment: Was terrified I would misread the pediatrician's scribble for my son's antibiotic. The app decoded the exact dosage and reminded me to separate his probiotic by 2 hours.

name: Marcus T.
comment: Simple, fast, and didn't force me to create an account or give up private health data. The instant analysis was spot-on with the pharmacist's label.

name: Elena R.
comment: Taking blood thinners and painkillers after knee surgery was confusing. The 24-hour visual schedule made timing each dose completely stress-free.
